relevance_note: Case report of a girl with PAMI syndrome and a PSTPIP1 variant: "Here, we report a patient who presented with features of PAMI syndrome and was found to have a de novovariant leading to amino acid substitution N236K in PSTPIP1."
method_note: Hand extraction, no script transcription of tables (the paper has no tables; Fig. 1 laboratory values are not in the text). Three in-scope people: the case-report patient ('patient'); the E250K PAMI patient whose blood transcriptome was profiled ('unnamed person 1'; no reference given for this person, only 'the published E250K variant', so rule 6 label; individual-level fact = variant); and the single PAMI patient previously reported with N236K in ref (2) ('ref (2) patient'; individual-level fact = variant). The healthy non-consanguineous parents get no rows: the paper never states they were tested or affected. Inheritance for the patient left 'not reported' although the paper calls the variant 'de novo': the paper does not state parental testing (rule 8/D-24); parental_testing_statement 'not reported'. 'There was concern for arthritis' is hedged, so the arthritis checklist item is 'not reported'; the discomfort on manipulation is recorded as observed with the concern as detail. 'No history of ... hepatosplenomegaly' is the combined finding; splenomegaly and hepatomegaly checklist items left 'not reported' (narrow-vs-broad rule). Pyoderma gangrenosum marked excluded from 'no history of skin ulceration'. 'neurologic evaluation was normal' recorded as 'abnormal neurologic evaluation' excluded, plus hearing impairment excluded from 'including auditive testing'; developmental delay excluded from 'appropriately met developmental milestones' (D-27). Leukocyte subsets 'slightly low on one occasion but normal on subsequent testing' not recorded (inconsistent over time, values only in Fig. 1A). MRP8/MRP14 explicitly not measured ('lack of data regarding MRP8 and MRP14 levels in this patient'), so hypercalprotectinemia is 'not reported'. Death at 22 mo: age at last evaluation and deceased age both P22M. Onset 'Between the ages of 1–6 mo' is a range, so onset ISO left null; the abstract also says 'neonatal-onset'. Functional evidence sentences name N236K (and E250K) directly, so they are given for each person carrying that exact variant. Genomic build not printed. n_patients_reported = 1 (the case reported first-hand); the transcriptome section describes 'PAMI patients (n = 2)' including the E250K patient. No contradictions found.
